issues.issue: The extractor's disbursement rules put water and drainage districts under 'natural resources/conservation'. An irrigation district arguably belongs there rather than in 'utilities'. This applies to disbursements[0]-[6].
An irrigation district isn't a power or utility district. 'other' (or natural resources district) may fit better; this is a judgment call.
The grantor isn't stated; it could be federal (e.g. Bureau of Reclamation). Already marked review.
Irrigation district assessments are per-acre water charges levied on irrigators, so they could arguably be charges for services. 'special assessments' follows the printed label and is defensible.
